scripts.build: node scripts/generate-no-globals.mjs && node scripts/generate-no-side-effects.mjs && sass src/index.scss:lib/index.min.css --style compressed && sass src/library-fonts.scss:lib/library-fonts.css --style compressed && sass src/local.scss:lib/local.css --style compressed && sass src/no-side-effects.scss:lib/no-side-effects.css --style compressed && sass src/no-globals.scss:lib/no-globals.css --style compressed && node scripts/copy-fonts.mjs
scripts.release: pnpm view $npm_package_name@$npm_package_version version >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "Version $npm_package_name@$npm_package_version already exists in registry. Skipping." || pnpm publish --no-git-checks
